flagged.evidence: The Statement assumes only that face-integrated fluxes satisfy “J_{K,F}=-J_{L,F}”; [A1] says “The normal flux has matching traces across each interior face,” and step 1.1 uses exact equality of those traces at y_F. Equality of face integrals does not imply exact pointwise equality there. The Hessian bound and face-integral equality do give an O(Mh) trace mismatch, enough for the claimed flux-defect estimate after a short adjustment, so this is a nonfatal proof gap.
